questions.question: Which property wrapper owns a small piece of a view's own changing state?
questions.why: @State owns; the others borrow or look up.

questions.question: What makes a model class usable by SwiftUI views with automatic updates?
questions.why: The Observation framework tracks reads and writes.

questions.question: How do you get a binding to a property of an @Observable object passed into a view?
questions.why: @Bindable makes bindings to an observable object's properties.

questions.question: What is "one source of truth"?

answers.text: Each piece of data is owned in exactly one place, and everything else reads or binds to it
Storing every value in one big struct

questions.why: Two copies of the same data drift apart; one owner never does.
